question: Should the dashboard’s new smoke-profile defaults and fail-closed invalid-selection behavior replace the prior permissive live flow-oriented launch behavior for existing QA Lab operators?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes an operator-facing request/default contract while repairing a real dashboard bug; code review can verify mechanics, but only the QA Lab owner can accept the intended default and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Confirm the new control-plane contract
options.body: Accept the taxonomy-owned smoke-profile defaults and fail-closed validation as the supported dashboard behavior, then merge after normal required checks complete.

options.title: Preserve the prior default behavior
options.body: Adjust the server-owned default profile or dashboard initialization so an empty existing request retains the legacy live flow-oriented behavior while explicit plans use the new controls.

options.title: Split the default-policy change
options.body: Land only the mixed-kind planning repair and defer any default-profile transition to a separately discussed QA Lab change.

recommendation.title: Confirm the new control-plane contract
recommendation.body: Accept the taxonomy-owned smoke-profile defaults and fail-closed validation as the supported dashboard behavior, then merge after normal required checks complete.
